result:
Both `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` pass cleanly (9 pass, 0 fail).

I fixed the open-redirect vulnerability in the login flow by adding `app/Http/Support/safeRedirectPath.ts`, a pure helper that only trusts a `redirect` value if it's a genuine same-app path: it strips tabs/newlines and normalizes backslashes to forward slashes (since browsers treat `/\evil.example` and `/\n/evil.example` the same as `//evil.example`), then rejects anything that doesn't start with a single `/` or that parses as a standalone absolute URL, falling back to a caller-supplied default otherwise. `app/Http/Controllers/Auth/LoginController.ts` now runs the validated `redirect` field through `safeRedirectPath(redirect, '/dashboard')` before redirecting post-login, so legitimate paths like `/posts/3/edit` still work while absolute URLs, `//evil.example`, and backslash tricks all fall back to `/dashboard`; authentication success/failure behavior is untouched. Added `tests/safeRedirectPath.test.ts` covering same-app paths, missing values, absolute URLs, protocol-relative URLs, backslash variants, and whitespace-hidden bypasses.
